meta.title: Experience | Guilherme Reis
meta.description: Guilherme Reis's professional path between product and engineering, building SaaS products, APIs, and management systems in production.

items.description: Building a work-management SaaS for small teams, bringing projects, cycles, tasks, notes, calendar, and daily priorities into a single workspace. I structured critical flows for authentication, access, business rules, and persistence with TypeScript, React, PostgreSQL, and Supabase. I implemented payments, product analytics, automated tests, CI/CD, and deployment on Vercel.

Led the architecture and development of a SaaS startup focused on prioritizing WhatsApp conversations that need a commercial follow-up, turning messages into trackable follow-up flows. I modeled the domains for organizations, teams, contacts, conversations, follow-ups, integrations, and automations. I drove the integration with Supabase, PostgreSQL, Edge Functions, and the WhatsApp Cloud API, including Embedded Signup and webhook processing.

Built a full stack platform for custom orders, structuring catalog, products, sizes, fillings, addresses, and orders into a single operational flow. I created a REST API with Node.js, Fastify, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and Drizzle ORM, with JWT, HTTP-only cookies, Zod, OpenAPI/Scalar, Vitest, and payment integration with AbacatePay.

Built screens, components, forms, and navigation with Laravel, Inertia.js, React, TypeScript, Vite, and Tailwind CSS. I standardized components, validations, and interactions with React Hook Form, Zod, Radix UI, and Motion, cutting duplication and making the codebase easier to maintain.

Built a system for managing negotiations, contracts, partners, and administrative workflows. I delivered dashboards, forms, spreadsheet import and export, file uploads, a documented REST API, JWT authentication, and tests with Vitest, using React, Fastify, PostgreSQL, and Drizzle ORM.
